summary: AVP, Asset Liability Management candidate with ~7 years across institutional ALM, interest rate risk analytics, investment-portfolio oversight, and IFRS-aligned financial reporting for insurance clients. Holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset portfolios at Moody's Analytics ($5–25bn per engagement). Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation at EY for Canadian insurers and stochastic ALM and hedging studies at Ortec Finance for pension and institutional clients. CFA charterholder; dual MSc, Western University.
core_skills: Equity hedging analytics (rates, FX, inflation derivatives)
Investment mandate monitoring & portfolio-level risk oversight
IFRS 17 & IFRS 9 (delivered transformation for Canadian insurers)

sections.heading: ALM Reporting, Strategy Assessment & Risk-Return Analysis
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities — translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.

Review and assess ALM configurations and analytical outputs to identify inconsistencies and opportunities to improve risk-return characterisation; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Interest Rate Risk, Derivatives Validation & Investment Mandate Oversight
bullets: Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks for multi-asset institutional portfolios, aligned with OSFI-style supervisory expectations.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-check sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates supporting hedge-positioning and rebalancing reviews.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics that feed downstream ALM, capital, and investment-mandate monitoring processes.

sections.heading: Cash Flow Projection, Stress Testing & Liquidity Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity and asset-allocation visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimisation, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioural cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform, advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners; scoped requirements, validated post-deployment model outputs, and migrated all assigned accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, risk, and IT functions on IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 adoption; contributed to governance documentation and OSFI regulatory-readiness processes.
Coordinated cross-functional delivery across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and programme management on implementation milestones.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors; analysed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base and stressed environments.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis and interest-rate, inflation, and currency hedging studies; advised clients on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs via stress and sensitivity testing.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimisation on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis.

Modelled pension-fund actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types; presented findings to investment committees, including the University Pension Plan merger study covering duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
